decisions.reason: The air quality sensor fits steady demand for indoor climate measurement and costs little to keep in a modular catalog, so the option stays open despite component supply pressure.
As the current generation of an established voltage measurement module it carries proven demand, and no successor is due yet.
The MQTT proxy costs almost nothing to keep available, but richer native MQTT bindings may make it redundant, so withdrawal is a real possibility even though it is kept for now.
CO2 monitoring demand rose strongly with ventilation concerns, which makes this a valuable option worth keeping despite supply constraints.
The touch panel accessory has low holding costs and niche but continuing use in projects with operator interfaces, so it stays while demand remains uncertain.
